title: Non-vanishing of multiple correlation sequences
summary: We resolve in the negative a conjecture of Frantzikinakis and Kuca concerning the vanishing of multiple correlation sequences in nilsystems. Specifically, we prove the existence of an ergodic $3$-step nilsystem $(G/Γ, μ_{G/Γ}, R_α)$ and bounded functions $f_0, f_1, f_2 \in L^\infty(μ_{G/Γ})$ orthogonal to the Conze--Lesigne factor $L^2(G/G_3Γ)$, whose associated multiple correlation sequence $$a(n) = \int_{G/Γ} f_0(x) f_1(α^n x) f_2(α^{2n} x) \, dμ_{G/Γ}(x)$$ does not decay to zero.
